checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: Ultra Balls at Indigo Plateau, healed, outdoors

events.why: Indigo Plateau's Center has the only Mart counter near a fly point that sells Ultra Balls.
Into the Center, facing the clerk across the counter.
10 Ultra Balls ($12,000): at full HP one catches an Ekans about two times in three, a Voltorb or a Drowzee one in two.
Healed at the nurse beside the clerk.
Outdoors, where each catch starts: none of them flies to Indigo Plateau, and Fly to the town the player stands in lands where it took off, which the fly action takes for no landing.

metadata.notes: Starts anywhere outdoors in Kanto and ends outside Indigo Plateau's Pokemon Center, healed. The bag's Poke Balls (8 on the Sevii save) catch Voltorb about one time in four.
